regressions.command: cd rust && cargo test --locked -p tidb-txnkv --lib mpp_failure_batch -- --test-threads=1
behavior: Stop returned before an in-flight probe released the transport.
Cooldown timestamp preceded completion of the health RPC.
regressions.fixture_refinement: Final cooldown vector compares recorded completion instants instead of a sleep threshold; existing TTL vectors no longer sleep.

changes: Process startup and transport shutdown compose the existing failed-store prober, with one scanner and joined active probes.
Foreground admission checks the failed map and registers failed probes using existing runtime/store fleet; deprecated TTL remains zero.
One raw gather feeds the shared decoder; the obsolete decoded task-concatenation owner/fixture is removed.
Hold two packets before delivery; at most three autoscaler Memory limit recoveries; never replay delivered data or local cancellation/quota errors.
Retain snapshot/query/schema across attempts; allocate new gather/task IDs and close old responses before reopening.
Carry session fallback policy through statement/pushdown snapshots.
Transfer packet memory ownership once and release held buffers/retry capabilities on every close/error/drop path.

checks: Recovery is below decoding and bounded before first result.
All task responses close on error; retry capabilities close with the response.
The prober stops before process transport retirement.
Health detection including channel acquisition has a bounded deadline.
Region-bearing dispatch remains single attempt as in Go; no unsupported fragment rescheduling added.
Canonical compute cache is explicitly unresolved; no second cache or transport pool was added.

publication: Final actual hook, fresh pre-push locked build, remote SHA and saved checkpoint are recorded in /workspace/.cloud-setup/mpp-failure-lifecycle-batch/final-handoff.json. No force push or hook bypass.
limits: No full copr/coordinator/planner or native package acceptance; no fresh exhaustive audit of54 broader findings.
Canonical PD compute-store cache/invalidation awaits storage-owner migration.

General physical fragments, coordinator registration/reporting and dispatch-time memory-limit recovery remain incomplete; this composes receive-time recovery for the existing single-fragment full scan.

No live multi-node TiKV/TiFlash/autoscaler service, full Go suite, broad platform sweep or benchmark was run. Socket fixtures verify real transport behavior but do not establish distributed production parity.
